sectors: Community paramedicine and mental health response

deep_lessons.title: Set up a department with the nine-step wizard

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Choose the appropriate EMS or mobile-crisis operating pack and review visit coverage and notification setup.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Choose Search and rescue, then review mapping, training, inventory and deployments.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Choose Security and facilities, then review site groups, patrol staffing and activity records.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use the Fire context with Contract workforce mix; review seasonal crews and deployment dates.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Choose Industrial response and applicable HazMat context; review facility groups, equipment and qualifications.

deep_lessons.title: Configure department-wide behavior

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Set the local time zone for scheduled outreach visits; review whether a daily reset would incorrectly mark an occupied response team available.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Choose availability reset rules that suit volunteers and overnight searches; avoid implying that a remote volunteer has arrived at staging.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Set patrol-day boundaries and display order; review staffing suppression before excluding an off-duty patrol member from alerts.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review reset times across overnight assignments and the deployment time zone before changing contractor crew availability.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Align display time with plant shifts and review automatic resets before overwriting a team engaged in an extended incident.

deep_lessons.title: Create statuses with useful operational meaning

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use labels such as En route to visit and Contact made with appropriate base meanings; include only approved operational notes.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use Searching assigned area with Searching meaning, an incident destination and an accountability note.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use On patrol, Investigating and Made contact with the corresponding base meanings; distinguish availability from patrol activity.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use Staging, Responding and Returning for crew movement; make notes capture the assigned division or staging point.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use Maintenance and Unavailable for defective equipment, and On scene for the response team; a label alone must not imply equipment readiness.

deep_lessons.title: Configure members, roles and administrator scope

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Create operational roles for clinicians and peer responders, then track credentials separately; membership does not establish clinical scope.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use roles such as Search Team Leader and Navigation Specialist; review current qualifications and actual availability before assignment.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use Patrol Officer and Site Supervisor roles; scope group administration to the intended site and reserve department administration for department-wide ownership.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use Crew Leader, Saw Operator and Driver roles; review seasonal roster membership and current credentials before deployment.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use ERT Leader, HazMat Technician and Equipment Operator roles; role labels do not replace qualification review.

deep_lessons.title: Model stations, site groups, apparatus and crew roles

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Model response areas or outreach teams as groups and mobile response vehicles as units; define team positions appropriate to the service.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Model bases and field teams as groups and search vehicles or boats as units; define team leader and operator positions.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Model clients or sites as groups and patrol vehicles as units; check membership before applying site-scoped dispatch.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Model bases and crews as groups and engines or support vehicles as units; require the appropriate driver or crew positions.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Model facilities or plants as groups and response vehicles or equipment as units; define operators and response-team positions.

deep_lessons.title: Control recipient selection and dispatch behavior

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Compare dispatching the scheduled mobile team with dispatching every member of its response-area group; review who should receive a visit alert.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Compare alerting the active search shift with paging an entire volunteer group; check crew propagation and excluded unavailable members.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Dispatch the on-duty patrol shift or selected site group; review whether assigning a vehicle should also alert its staffed officers.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Dispatch the assigned crew and support vehicle; verify that off-assignment contractor personnel are not unintentionally included.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Dispatch the on-duty facility team; review department-wide specialist role exceptions before enabling group-scoped recipient selection.

deep_lessons.title: Build a reviewed run card and recommendation rules

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Create a reviewed response classification for a mobile-team request; specify eligible resource types and leave clinical triage to approved procedures.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use terrain or search classification to recommend a ground team, boat or specialist resource; review location freshness and qualifications.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use site and incident type to recommend a patrol vehicle and supervisor; inspect recommendations before committing recipients.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use assignment type to recommend crew, engine and support resources; review staffing and deployment availability.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use facility and incident class to recommend plant ERT and specialist equipment; inspect coverage and manual exceptions.

deep_lessons.title: Create shifts, sign-ups and coverage review

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Schedule mobile-crisis or outreach coverage windows and eligible team roles; review gaps and overlapping assignments.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Schedule search standby and field-team coverage with eligible roles; do not confuse sign-up with arrival at staging.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Schedule site patrol coverage and supervisor positions; review whether members may sign up for multiple shift groups.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Schedule crew availability and relief windows; check conflicts with deployments and rest requirements.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Schedule facility ERT coverage across plant shifts; review required positions and overlapping assignments.

deep_lessons.title: Create static workshifts and review unit commitments

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use a static shift to reserve a response vehicle for a defined outreach period; the start and end delimit its commitment.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use a static shift to reserve a search vehicle or boat for an operational period; review its assigned units and commitment dates.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use a static shift to reserve patrol vehicles for an event or site assignment; review start and end times and availability effects.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use a static shift to reserve crew apparatus during travel and assignment; review commitment through the return date.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use a static shift to reserve facility response equipment for a drill or temporary assignment; review unit commitments.

deep_lessons.title: Configure maps, locations and points of interest

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use current operational team positions for visit coverage; choose a location lifetime and follow the service’s location-access procedures.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Set a location lifetime suitable for remote search updates; use search-area POIs and distinguish stale positions from current team location.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Map patrol vehicles and site POIs; review stale-location lifetime before treating an old position as current patrol coverage.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Map staging, divisions and support vehicles; review device update frequency and stale location during remote assignments.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Map facility access points, response equipment and team positions; review indoor or weak-signal limitations and fallback procedures.

deep_lessons.title: Configure the Big Board display and status highlighting

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Show response-team availability and active work on a coordination display; select an appropriate operational view and protect sensitive details.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Show search-team status, incident and staging context; choose status aging thresholds that prompt a check-in.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Show patrol status and site coverage; configure aging thresholds for a missed patrol update.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Show deployed crews and apparatus status; use staging and response thresholds appropriate to the assignment.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Show facility response resources and incidents; use equipment and response-status thresholds for control-room review.

deep_lessons.title: Use chat channels, messages and acknowledgements

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use operational chat for team coordination and handover; keep detailed clinical records in the approved record workflow.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use team chat for search coordination and logistics; confirm incident assignments separately.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use site or patrol chat for low-impact coordination; review recipients before posting client-specific information.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use crew chat for staging and logistics; ensure time-critical instructions also follow approved communications procedures.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use facility chat for coordination and equipment updates; record defects and incidents in their owning workflows.

deep_lessons.title: Use the Assistant and understand AI prerequisites

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Ask for help locating setup or operational information, then check it on the owning screen; the assistant is not clinical decision support.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Ask how to locate search-team or configuration information; verify the answer and current source records.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Ask for help with patrol workflow configuration; inspect site scope and source data before acting.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Ask how to find deployment or crew setup information; verify current assignment data and provider availability.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Ask for help finding facility workflows; validate answers against current records and approved procedures.

deep_lessons.title: Use Admin Assist to review changes and follow up

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use evidence checks to review roster, communications and upcoming credentials; investigate findings with the service owner.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Review empty groups, qualifications and shift conflicts before the next search exercise.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Review patrol groups, administrative access and shift conflicts before expanding site coverage.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review seasonal members, qualification expiry and deployment-related setup gaps before mobilization.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Review facility groups, credentials and equipment-related setup findings; retain unresolved items in the handover.

deep_lessons.title: Configure stock and complete an inventory movement

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Track operational kits and consumables by location; record issues and returns without exposing clinical information.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Track rope, radios and search kits; issue equipment to a team, then reconcile returns and damaged items.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Track radios, PPE and site keys as appropriate to inventory policy; reconcile equipment issued to patrol staff.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Track tools, hose and consumables by base or crew; record transfers and returns after an assignment.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Track PPE, spill supplies and response kits; review stock, expiry and damaged equipment.

deep_lessons.title: Create and review operational records

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use an approved operational record definition for visits or responses; select fields and access according to the service’s record policy.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Record search activity, participants and outcomes; distinguish a saved draft from a reviewed or finalized record.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Record patrol or incident activity under an appropriate definition; review required fields and client/site access.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Record assignment activity and crew evidence; link the correct call or deployment and retain review status.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Record drills and response activity; review the definition, participants and finalization requirements.

deep_lessons.title: Create training and track participation

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Assign approved response and outreach training; review acknowledgments and completion separately from competency or authorization.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Assign navigation, search and equipment training; follow up on incomplete sessions.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Assign site procedures and incident-report training; review acknowledgment and completion before assigning duties.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Assign seasonal crew and equipment training; review completion before mobilization.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Assign facility ERT, PPE and response-procedure training; track completion and follow-up.

deep_lessons.title: Track qualifications and expiry

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Track relevant professional and operational credentials and expiry dates; verify originals and renewal requirements with the responsible owner.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Track search, rescue and equipment qualifications; review expiry before allocating specialist roles.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Track applicable licenses and operational qualifications; review expiry before site assignment.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Track crew and operator qualifications and seasonal renewals; verify records before deployment.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Track relevant ERT and equipment qualifications and inspections; review impending expiry and renewal evidence.

deep_lessons.title: Configure shared contacts and organizations

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Maintain approved referral and partner contacts with organizational access rules; keep operational contact notes distinct from clinical records.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Maintain land-manager, mutual-aid and logistics contacts for a search area.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Maintain client/site contacts and escalation instructions; check access and update ownership.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Maintain agency, staging, vendor and assignment contacts; verify who owns current details.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Maintain facility, contractor and external-response contacts with escalation notes appropriate to policy.

deep_lessons.title: Review subscription capacity and add-on access

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Compare active member counts and enabled modules with subscription capacity; identify the owner of subscription changes.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Plan seasonal volunteer capacity and relevant add-ons before increasing the roster.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Compare patrol-company roster growth and add-on needs with subscription capacity; review purchases with the account owner.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review seasonal contractor roster and required add-ons; distinguish subscription billing from deployment cost recovery.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Review facility roster and operational add-ons against subscription capacity; confirm external billing-system status.

deep_lessons.title: Configure workforce costing and evidence

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Set worker classifications, operational assignments and reviewed time workflow appropriate to the service.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Set workforce tracking only where needed, separating volunteer availability from any payable work.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Associate staff, client/site assignments and reviewed worked time; configure compensation and cost allocation according to approved policy.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Associate contractor crew, assignment and reviewed worked time; retain rate and cost evidence for authorized finance review.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Associate facility staff, work classifications and approved time; review organization-specific approval and compensation rules.

deep_lessons.title: Create and staff an operational deployment

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Plan an outreach event or temporary response-coverage deployment with dates, roster and operational objectives.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Plan a search deployment with staging, operational period, personnel and resource roster.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Plan event-security or temporary site coverage with an operational roster and dates.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Plan a crew assignment with operational dates and resources; review cost evidence separately from the operational roster.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Plan plant turnaround or mutual-aid coverage with dates, response resources and responsible reviewers.

deep_lessons.title: Choose reports and verify the exported evidence

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Report operational coverage, response activity and training progress; interpret metrics according to the service’s approved definitions.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Report search activity, team participation and readiness gaps; verify filters and source records.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Report patrol/site activity and coverage; review filters before sending a client-facing result.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Report crew deployment activity and reviewed cost evidence; distinguish missing records from zero activity.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Report facility incidents, drills and readiness; review the time zone, date range and source completeness.

deep_lessons.title: Publish checklists and verify completion

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use a vehicle or operational-kit checklist; follow up on failed items and distinguish scheduled compliance from an on-demand check.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use search-kit and vehicle readiness checks; assign failed equipment follow-up.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use patrol vehicle or site-opening checks; review failures and missed scheduled checks.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use crew and apparatus readiness checks before mobilization; create accountable defect follow-up.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use response-kit and equipment checks; review required items and route failures to maintenance.

deep_lessons.title: Manage equipment faults and repair follow-up

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Turn a response-vehicle or kit defect into a work order with an owner, state and completion evidence.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Track defective radios or search equipment through review, repair and return to service.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Track patrol equipment and vehicle defects through assigned repairs and verification.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Track apparatus and tool defects with assignment impact and return-to-service evidence.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Track response-equipment defects through repair ownership and verified completion.

deep_lessons.title: Connect contracts, bids and invoicing to operations

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Connect approved operational activity to the service’s cost workflow; review eligibility and export prerequisites outside the operational roster.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Keep operational search records and any approved cost evidence together without assuming reimbursement eligibility.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Connect client/site service activity to reviewed costs and invoices; verify source activity before authorized billing.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Connect crew assignment activity and approved costs to the contracting workflow; validate rates and evidence before financial submission.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Connect facility or contracted response activity to reviewed internal cost allocation and invoicing where applicable.

deep_lessons.title: Configure messages and review recipients

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Review eligible channels and intended team recipients before an authorized communication test; configuration alone does not prove delivery.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Review volunteer alert channels and inactive members; test reviewed recipients and fallback communications.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Review site/patrol alert recipients and channel preferences; prove delivery through a reviewed test.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review crew communication channels and remote-connectivity limitations before mobilization.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Review on-duty facility recipients and specialist escalation channels; test reviewed recipients and fallback procedures.

deep_lessons.title: Configure incident classification and intake pathways

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Use an approved operational request type for a visit or mobile response; keep clinical triage and sensitive detail under the service’s procedures.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Use Rescue or a reviewed search type and clear staging information; select the appropriate team.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Use Investigation or a reviewed patrol incident type with the correct site and selected resources.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Use a reviewed assignment or incident type and staging details; select crew and support resources.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Use a reviewed facility incident type and access location; select the facility team and specialist equipment.

deep_lessons.title: Configure reference content, events and templates

sector_examples.Search and rescue: Organize search, navigation and equipment protocols and mutual-aid references.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Organize site instructions, escalation procedures and patrol reference documents.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Organize assignment, equipment and agency procedures with seasonal review ownership.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Organize facility response plans, access instructions and equipment procedures with current owners.

deep_lessons.title: Connect applications and review integration setup

sector_examples.Search and rescue: Choose field-member, dispatch and coordination-display apps; verify location update and remote connectivity.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Choose patrol-member, dispatcher and site-display apps; verify site scope and device registration.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Choose crew-member, dispatch and coordination apps; verify device updates during remote assignments.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Choose responder, control-room and display apps; verify provider prerequisites and facility connectivity.

primer_lessons.title: Set up voice channels for team coordination

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Plan operational team channels and verify device and add-on prerequisites.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Plan search-team and staging channels; test approved participants and fallback radio procedures.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Plan site and patrol channels with intended memberships; test authorized device access.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Plan crew and staging channels; test connectivity and approved fallback communications.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Plan facility response channels; test device access and approved fallback communications.

primer_lessons.title: Plan protected-data access and recovery

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Review protected-record access, key and recovery prerequisites according to the service’s policy.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Review protected operational details and recovery ownership; verify authorized access.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Review client/site protected-data access and recovery responsibilities.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review protected assignment data and key/recovery ownership.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Review protected facility information and recovery procedures with responsible owners.

primer_lessons.title: Match subscription capacity to the roster

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Compare active member counts and enabled modules with subscription capacity; identify the owner of subscription changes.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Plan seasonal volunteer capacity and relevant add-ons before increasing the roster.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Compare patrol-company roster growth and add-on needs with subscription capacity; review purchases with the account owner.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review seasonal contractor roster and required add-ons; distinguish subscription billing from deployment cost recovery.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Review facility roster and operational add-ons against subscription capacity; confirm external billing-system status.

primer_lessons.title: Understand AI availability and human review

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Ask for help locating setup or operational information, then check it on the owning screen; the assistant is not clinical decision support.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Ask how to locate search-team or configuration information; verify the answer and current source records.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Ask for help with patrol workflow configuration; inspect site scope and source data before acting.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Ask how to find deployment or crew setup information; verify current assignment data and provider availability.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Ask for help finding facility workflows; validate answers against current records and approved procedures.

primer_lessons.title: Relay: bring an audio dispatch feed into Resgrid

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: If an approved audio dispatch feed exists, configure an appropriate reviewed relay source; validate transcription and recipient selection.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Review the authorized dispatch audio source, transcription quality and search-team classification before using Relay.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Review whether the organization has an appropriate authorized audio feed; validate site classification and recipients.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Review the authorized assignment/dispatch feed and remote connection prerequisites; verify parsed output.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Review the authorized control-room dispatch feed and provider prerequisites; verify parsed incident details.

primer_lessons.title: Self-hosting: configuration and operating responsibilities

sector_examples.Community paramedicine and mental health: Configure isolated service providers and test operational workflows; review protected-data handling and backups.
sector_examples.Search and rescue: Configure databases, workers and mapping providers; test remote devices and restore procedures.
sector_examples.Security companies and departments: Configure department/site boundaries, providers and worker operations; test actual device and alert behavior.
sector_examples.Wildland contractors: Configure providers and workers and test deployment workflows; review remote connectivity and backups.
sector_examples.Industrial emergency response teams: Configure facility providers, worker processing and backups; test restore and external system boundaries.
